summary: Add Java domain classes for SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine, and Customer, establishing parent-child relationships between sales orders and order lines, as well as associating sales orders with customers.
approach: Create plain old Java object (POJO) domain classes (SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine, and Customer) in standard package structures under src/main/java/com/neversoft/. SalesOrder will manage order header attributes, a reference to a Customer, and a list of SalesOrderLine child items. SalesOrderLine will represent individual order items (e.g. product/item identifier, quantity, unit price, total), and Customer will represent customer information. Each class will provide standard private fields, no-argument and parameterized constructors, getters and setters, and consistent equals, hashCode, and toString implementations without external dependencies, matching the existing domain style in the repository.

alternatives_considered.option: Single composite class or inner static classes
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Separate top-level domain classes provide better modularity, separation of concerns, and ease of extension as domain models grow.
To maintain consistency with existing POJO conventions (Vehicle.java), enable mutability for order lifecycle changes, and support broader framework compatibility.
No database infrastructure or ORM dependencies exist in the repository; domain models should remain lightweight and dependency-free.
The project does not use Lombok or annotation-processing build plugins.

components: Sales domain model (new) - new SalesOrder and SalesOrderLine domain classes representing orders and line items
Customer domain model (new) - new Customer domain class representing customer entities associated with orders
assumptions: Classes will follow plain Java object (POJO) conventions consistent with Vehicle.java.
Initial field sets for SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine, and Customer are sensible domain defaults and can be adapted in future issues.
No external persistence or database frameworks are required.

risks.risk: Domain field requirements evolve as business logic is added
risks.mitigation: Maintain simple, decoupled POJO classes so field additions and modifications are trivial.

risks.risk: Circular reference between SalesOrder and SalesOrderLine in toString/hashCode/equals
risks.mitigation: Avoid bidirectional reference recursion in toString and hash calculations.

risks.risk: Package naming conflicts with future modularization
risks.mitigation: Use conventional package paths (e.g. com.neversoft.sales and com.neversoft.customer).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A public SalesOrder class is created with fields for order identification, order date, status, customer reference, and a collection of SalesOrderLine objects.
A public SalesOrderLine class is created with fields for line identification, item description or code, quantity, unit price, and line amount.
A public Customer class is created with fields for customer identification, name, and contact details.
SalesOrder provides methods to associate with a Customer and manage its collection of SalesOrderLine child objects.
All domain classes provide no-arg constructors, parameterized constructors, getters, setters, and consistent equals, hashCode, and toString methods.
All classes compile cleanly with standard JDK (javac) with no external dependencies and no warnings.
No existing repository files are modified.
